ops.sql: SELECT d.Diagram_ID, d.Name, d.ParentID FROM t_diagram d WHERE d.Diagram_ID BETWEEN 1178 AND 1194

SELECT l.DiagramID, l.ConnectorID, l.Hidden FROM t_diagramlinks l WHERE l.DiagramID BETWEEN 1178 AND 1194
